sql: SELECT year,month,COUNT(*) currency_rows,MIN(to_us) min_rate,MAX(to_us) max_rate FROM currency WHERE country='France' AND year=2021 GROUP BY year,month ORDER BY month

WITH hist AS (SELECT s.prod_id,t.calendar_year yr,t.calendar_month_number month,SUM(s.amount_sold) sales_amount FROM sales s JOIN times t ON t.time_id=s.time_id JOIN customers c ON c.cust_id=s.cust_id JOIN countries cn ON cn.country_id=c.country_id JOIN channels ch ON ch.channel_id=s.channel_id JOIN promotions pm ON pm.promo_id=s.promo_id WHERE cn.country_name='France' AND ch.channel_total_id=1 AND pm.promo_total_id=1 AND t.calendar_year IN (2019,2020) GROUP BY s.prod_id,t.calendar_year,t.calendar_month_number), projections AS (SELECT b.prod_id,b.month,a.sales_amount s19,b.sales_amount s20,b.sales_amount*(1+(b.sales_amount-a.sales_amount)/a.sales_amount) local_forecast FROM hist a JOIN hist b ON a.prod_id=b.prod_id AND a.month=b.month AND a.yr=2019 AND b.yr=2020 WHERE a.sales_amount>0),usd AS (SELECT p.*,COALESCE(c.to_us,1) rate,p.local_forecast*COALESCE(c.to_us,1) usd_forecast FROM projections p LEFT JOIN currency c ON c.country='France' AND c.year=2021 AND c.month=p.month) SELECT month,COUNT(*) products,SUM(s19) baseline,SUM(s20) following_year,AVG(usd_forecast) avg_projection,MIN(usd_forecast) min_projection,MAX(usd_forecast) max_projection FROM usd GROUP BY month ORDER BY month

WITH hist AS (SELECT s.prod_id,t.calendar_year yr,t.calendar_month_number month,SUM(s.amount_sold) sales_amount FROM sales s JOIN times t ON t.time_id=s.time_id JOIN customers c ON c.cust_id=s.cust_id JOIN countries cn ON cn.country_id=c.country_id JOIN channels ch ON ch.channel_id=s.channel_id JOIN promotions pm ON pm.promo_id=s.promo_id WHERE cn.country_name='France' AND ch.channel_total_id=1 AND pm.promo_total_id=1 AND t.calendar_year IN (2019,2020) GROUP BY s.prod_id,t.calendar_year,t.calendar_month_number), projections AS (SELECT b.prod_id,b.month,a.sales_amount s19,b.sales_amount s20,b.sales_amount*(1+(b.sales_amount-a.sales_amount)/a.sales_amount) local_forecast FROM hist a JOIN hist b ON a.prod_id=b.prod_id AND a.month=b.month AND a.yr=2019 AND b.yr=2020 WHERE a.sales_amount>0),usd AS (SELECT p.*,COALESCE(c.to_us,1) rate,p.local_forecast*COALESCE(c.to_us,1) usd_forecast FROM projections p LEFT JOIN currency c ON c.country='France' AND c.year=2021 AND c.month=p.month) SELECT prod_id,month,s19,s20,local_forecast,(s20-s19)/s19 growth FROM usd ORDER BY local_forecast DESC LIMIT 5

WITH hist AS (SELECT s.prod_id,t.calendar_year yr,t.calendar_month_number month,SUM(s.amount_sold) sales_amount FROM sales s JOIN times t ON t.time_id=s.time_id JOIN customers c ON c.cust_id=s.cust_id JOIN countries cn ON cn.country_id=c.country_id JOIN channels ch ON ch.channel_id=s.channel_id JOIN promotions pm ON pm.promo_id=s.promo_id WHERE cn.country_name='France' AND ch.channel_total_id=1 AND pm.promo_total_id=1 AND t.calendar_year IN (2019,2020) GROUP BY s.prod_id,t.calendar_year,t.calendar_month_number), projections AS (SELECT b.prod_id,b.month,a.sales_amount s19,b.sales_amount s20,b.sales_amount*(1+(b.sales_amount-a.sales_amount)/a.sales_amount) local_forecast FROM hist a JOIN hist b ON a.prod_id=b.prod_id AND a.month=b.month AND a.yr=2019 AND b.yr=2020 WHERE a.sales_amount>0),usd AS (SELECT p.*,COALESCE(c.to_us,1) rate,p.local_forecast*COALESCE(c.to_us,1) usd_forecast FROM projections p LEFT JOIN currency c ON c.country='France' AND c.year=2021 AND c.month=p.month) SELECT month,ROUND(AVG(usd_forecast),2) average_projected_monthly_sales_usd FROM usd GROUP BY month ORDER BY month

WITH hist AS (SELECT s.prod_id,t.calendar_year yr,t.calendar_month_number month,SUM(s.amount_sold) sales_amount FROM sales s JOIN times t ON t.time_id=s.time_id JOIN customers c ON c.cust_id=s.cust_id JOIN countries cn ON cn.country_id=c.country_id JOIN channels ch ON ch.channel_id=s.channel_id JOIN promotions pm ON pm.promo_id=s.promo_id WHERE cn.country_name='France' AND ch.channel_total_id=1 AND pm.promo_total_id=1 AND t.calendar_year IN (2019,2020) GROUP BY s.prod_id,t.calendar_year,t.calendar_month_number), projections AS (SELECT b.prod_id,b.month,a.sales_amount s19,b.sales_amount s20,b.sales_amount*(1+(b.sales_amount-a.sales_amount)/a.sales_amount) local_forecast FROM hist a JOIN hist b ON a.prod_id=b.prod_id AND a.month=b.month AND a.yr=2019 AND b.yr=2020 WHERE a.sales_amount>0),usd AS (SELECT p.*,COALESCE(c.to_us,1) rate,p.local_forecast*COALESCE(c.to_us,1) usd_forecast FROM projections p LEFT JOIN currency c ON c.country='France' AND c.year=2021 AND c.month=p.month) SELECT month,ROUND(AVG(usd_forecast),2) average_projected_monthly_sales_usd FROM usd GROUP BY month ORDER BY month

WITH hist AS (SELECT s.prod_id,t.calendar_year yr,t.calendar_month_number month,SUM(s.amount_sold) sales_amount FROM sales s JOIN times t ON t.time_id=s.time_id JOIN customers c ON c.cust_id=s.cust_id JOIN countries cn ON cn.country_id=c.country_id JOIN channels ch ON ch.channel_id=s.channel_id JOIN promotions pm ON pm.promo_id=s.promo_id WHERE cn.country_name='France' AND ch.channel_total_id=1 AND pm.promo_total_id=1 AND t.calendar_year IN (2019,2020,2021) GROUP BY s.prod_id,t.calendar_year,t.calendar_month_number),p AS (SELECT a.prod_id,a.month,a.sales_amount s19,b.sales_amount s20,c.sales_amount s21,b.sales_amount*b.sales_amount/a.sales_amount v FROM hist a JOIN hist b ON a.prod_id=b.prod_id AND a.month=b.month AND a.yr=2019 AND b.yr=2020 LEFT JOIN hist c ON c.prod_id=a.prod_id AND c.month=a.month AND c.yr=2021 WHERE a.sales_amount>0) SELECT month,COUNT(*) history_products,SUM(s21 IS NOT NULL) roster_2021,ROUND(AVG(v),2) independent,ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN s21 IS NOT NULL THEN v END),2) roster_month_round,ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN s21 IS NOT NULL THEN ROUND(v,2) END),2) roster_product_and_month_round FROM p GROUP BY month ORDER BY month

WITH hist AS (SELECT s.prod_id,t.calendar_year yr,t.calendar_month_number month,SUM(s.amount_sold) sales_amount FROM sales s JOIN times t ON t.time_id=s.time_id JOIN customers c ON c.cust_id=s.cust_id JOIN countries cn ON cn.country_id=c.country_id JOIN channels ch ON ch.channel_id=s.channel_id JOIN promotions pm ON pm.promo_id=s.promo_id WHERE cn.country_name='France' AND ch.channel_total_id=1 AND pm.promo_total_id=1 AND t.calendar_year IN (2019,2020,2021) GROUP BY s.prod_id,t.calendar_year,t.calendar_month_number),p AS (SELECT a.prod_id,a.month,a.sales_amount s19,b.sales_amount s20,c.sales_amount s21,b.sales_amount*b.sales_amount/a.sales_amount v FROM hist a JOIN hist b ON a.prod_id=b.prod_id AND a.month=b.month AND a.yr=2019 AND b.yr=2020 LEFT JOIN hist c ON c.prod_id=a.prod_id AND c.month=a.month AND c.yr=2021 WHERE a.sales_amount>0) SELECT prod_id,month,s19,s20,v FROM p WHERE s21 IS NULL ORDER BY month,prod_id LIMIT 12
